zh.name: 至高，至阳，天空的化身
zh.desc: 天空之泰坦。融合神。被人征服，与人融合，不再宰制翁法罗斯的昼夜，却仍不改孤绝高傲的本性。\n在它眼中，破碎世界的凡俗是如此丑陋——比起由光明守护的世界，浑浑噩噩的庸人反而与黑潮更加相配。

skill_list.skill_desc: 进入蓄力状态，下次行动施放【怒，焚晨昏日星】。为自身附加【<u>氦闪</u>】，并召唤【阳雷之鸦】。此状态下，我方施放攻击后，将根据本次攻击击中的敌方目标数量降低【<u>氦闪</u>】。

240150102.name: 氦闪
240150102.desc: 当【至高，至阳，天空的化身】施放【怒，焚晨昏日星】后会根据当前【氦闪】提高【温度】。此状态下，当我方攻击后，将根据本次攻击击中的敌方目标数量降低【氦闪】。

skill_list.skill_desc: 根据当前自身的【<u>氦闪</u>】对我方全体目标造成大量火属性伤害，伤害由目标<u>平均分摊</u>，同时根据当前【<u>氦闪</u>】升高【<u>温度</u>】，并<u>修复</u>【百眼之末】和【百眼之梢】。

401301001.desc: 本次攻击结算前的伤害和负面效果由所有受击目标平均承受。

240150103.name: 雷云
240150103.desc: 当前战场环境积蓄的雷云，当【至高，至阳，天空的化身】施放【愤，破昼夜长空】后会根据【雷云】层数对我方造成对应次数的少量雷属性伤害，之后根据我方争夺的【雷云】数对自身造成少量雷属性伤害。

240150105.name: 修复
240150105.desc: 解除指定敌方目标的控制类负面状态与弱点击破状态，若此时指定敌方目标处于不可选中状态，则使其重新进入可选中状态。

240150103.name: 雷云

240150103.name: 雷云
240150103.desc: 当前战场环境积蓄的雷云，当【至高，至阳，天空的化身】施放【愤，破昼夜长空】后会根据【雷云】层数对我方造成对应次数的少量雷属性伤害，之后根据我方争夺的【雷云】数对自身造成少量雷属性伤害。

240150105.desc: 解除指定敌方目标的控制类负面状态与弱点击破状态，若此时指定敌方目标处于不可选中状态，则使其重新进入可选中状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 增加【<u>雷云</u>】层数，进入蓄力状态，下次行动施放【愤，破昼夜长空】。为自身附加【<u>电离</u>】，并召唤【阳雷之鸦】。此状态下，我方施放攻击后，将根据本次攻击击中的敌方目标数量争夺【<u>雷云</u>】层数，【阳雷之鸦】、【百眼之末】或【百眼之梢】受到致命攻击时我方将会争夺一定数量的【<u>雷云</u>】层数。

240150103.name: 雷云
240150103.desc: 当前战场环境积蓄的雷云，当【至高，至阳，天空的化身】施放【愤，破昼夜长空】后会根据【雷云】层数对我方造成对应次数的少量雷属性伤害，之后根据我方争夺的【雷云】数对自身造成少量雷属性伤害。

240150104.name: 电离
240150104.desc: 此状态下，我方施放攻击后，将根据本次攻击击中的敌方目标数量争夺【雷云】层数，【阳雷之鸦】、【百眼之末】或【百眼之梢】受到致命攻击时我方将会争夺一定数量的【雷云】层数。若所有【雷云】均被我方争夺，则会使自身陷入弱点击破状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体造成雷属性伤害，并消耗一定数量【<u>雷云</u>】。对随机我方目标造成对应次数的少量雷属性伤害，并<u>修复</u>【百眼之末】和【百眼之梢】。之后根据我方争夺的雷云数对自身造成对应次数的少量雷属性附加伤害。

240150105.name: 修复
240150105.desc: 解除指定敌方目标的控制类负面状态与弱点击破状态，若此时指定敌方目标处于不可选中状态，则使其重新进入可选中状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 本次战斗中，对【阳雷之鸦】、【百眼之末】或【百眼之梢】造成伤害时，【至高，至阳，天空的化身】也会损失相等的生命值。当【阳雷之鸦】、【百眼之末】或【百眼之梢】受到致命攻击时，【至高，至阳，天空的化身】会受到韧性伤害，且【百眼之末】或【百眼之梢】回复生命值并进入不可选中状态。
处在雷云天时，战场环境拥有【<u>雷云</u>】。当【至高，至阳，天空的化身】未处于【<u>电离</u>】状态时，【阳雷之鸦】、【百眼之末】或【百眼之梢】受到致命攻击时将会减少一定数量的【<u>雷云</u>】层数，并对【至高，至阳，天空的化身】造成少量雷属性伤害。

240150103.name: 雷云
240150103.desc: 当前战场环境积蓄的雷云，当【至高，至阳，天空的化身】施放【愤，破昼夜长空】后会根据【雷云】层数对我方造成对应次数的少量雷属性伤害，之后根据我方争夺的【雷云】数对自身造成少量雷属性伤害。

240150104.name: 电离
240150104.desc: 此状态下，我方施放攻击后，将根据本次攻击击中的敌方目标数量争夺【雷云】层数，【阳雷之鸦】、【百眼之末】或【百眼之梢】受到致命攻击时我方将会争夺一定数量的【雷云】层数。若所有【雷云】均被我方争夺，则会使自身陷入弱点击破状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 处在晴天时，战场环境拥有【<u>温度</u>】。当任意目标回合开始时，升高【<u>温度</u>】。我方目标造成的伤害将根据【<u>温度</u>】提高。使我方全体目标陷入【太阳风暴】，当我方回合开始时，将根据【<u>温度</u>】造成火属性伤害，该伤害<u>【不致命】</u>。当【阳雷之鸦】、【百眼之末】或【百眼之梢】受到致命攻击时，将会降低【<u>温度</u>】。

240150101.name: 温度
240150101.desc: 当前战场环境的温度，我方会根据温度受到持续的灼烧伤害。我方目标造成的伤害将根据温度提高。

401403001.name: 不致命
401403001.desc: 目标受到伤害时，若目标生命值不足，则会将生命值降低至1点。

en.name: Ishtar Huwawa Aquila
en.desc: The Sky Titan. Theos Synthetos. Conquered by and fused with humanity, they no longer govern Amphoreus' cycle of day and night, yet their haughtiness remains unchanged.\nIn their mind, the shattered world's mundane mortals are unsightly. Compared to a world safeguarded by light, the mindless human masses seem more befitting of the black tide.

skill_list.skill_desc: Raises "<u>Temperature</u>." Launches several attacks from the left side of the target team, and delivers a 1-time priority attack to each target, with the remaining attack counts attacking one random target each. Each attack deals Fire DMG based on the current "<u>Temperature</u>," as well as <u>reinstates</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes."

240150101.desc: The current temperature on the battlefield. Allies will take continuous Burn DMG based on the temperature. DMG dealt by ally targets increases based on Temperature.

240150105.desc: Dispels the Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken state from designated friendly units. If the designated friendly units are not currently selectable, causes them to become selectable.

When in this state, after a target uses an attack, reduces "<u>Helium Flash</u>" based on the number of friendly units hit in this attack.

240150102.name: Helium Flash
240150102.desc: After "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" uses "Fury, Incineration of Dawn and Dusk," "Temperature" increases based on the current "Helium Flash." Under this state, after allies use an attack, "Helium Flash" is reduced based on the number of enemy targets hit by this attack.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals massive Fire DMG to all targets based on this unit's current "<u>Helium Flash</u>." The DMG is <u>distributed evenly</u> among targets while also raising the "<u>Temperature</u>" based on the current "<u>Helium Flash</u>" and <u>reinstating</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" and "Twig of Hundred Eyes."

401301001.name: Even Distribution
401301001.desc: The DMG and debuff before this attack's finalization is received evenly by all targets that are hit.

240150103.desc: The accumulated stack of Thunderclouds in the current battlefield. Afterward, minor Lightning DMG will be dealt to this unit based on the number of "Thunderclouds" seized by allies.

skill_list.skill_desc: Increases "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks and enters Charging state. Uses "Wrath, Rend of Eternal Sky" in the next action. This unit gains "<u>Ionization</u>" and summons "Daythunder Raven." In this state, after targets attack, seizes "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks based on the number of friendly units hit in the attack. When "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receives a killing blow, targets seize a set number of "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks.

240150103.name: Thundercloud
240150103.desc: The accumulated stack of Thunderclouds in the current battlefield. After "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" uses "Wrath, Rend of Eternal Sky," inflicts minor Lightning DMG on ally targets based on the number of "Thundercloud" stacks. Afterward, minor Lightning DMG will be dealt to this unit based on the number of "Thunderclouds" seized by allies.

240150104.name: Ionization
240150104.desc: In this state, after targets attack, they seize "Thundercloud" stacks based on number of friendly units hit in this attack. When "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receives a killing blow, target seizes a set number of "Thundercloud" stacks. If all "Thundercloud" stacks have been seized, this unit will enter the Weakness Break state.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Lightning DMG to all targets and consumes a certain amount of "<u>Thundercloud(s)</u>." Deals a corresponding number of instances of minor Lightning DMG to random target and <u>reinstates</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" and "Twig of Hundred Eyes." Afterward, deals a corresponding number of instances of minor Lightning Additional DMG to this unit based on the contested Thunderclouds between the targets and this unit.

240150105.name: Reinstate
240150105.desc: Dispels the Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken state from designated friendly units. If the designated friendly units are not currently selectable, causes them to become selectable.

skill_list.skill_desc: During this battle, upon inflicting DMG to "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes," "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" will also lose an equivalent amount of HP. When "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receives a killing blow, "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" will also receive Toughness DMG, and "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" will heal themselves and cannot be selected.

When it storms, the environment will have "<u>Thunderclouds</u>." When "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receives a killing blow while "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" is not in "<u>Ionization</u>" state, reduces a certain amount of "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks and deals minor Lightning DMG to "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky."

240150103.name: Thundercloud
240150103.desc: The accumulated stack of Thunderclouds in the current battlefield. After "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" uses "Wrath, Rend of Eternal Sky," inflicts minor Lightning DMG on ally targets based on the number of "Thundercloud" stacks. Afterward, minor Lightning DMG will be dealt to this unit based on the number of "Thunderclouds" seized by allies.

240150104.name: Ionization
240150104.desc: In this state, after targets attack, they seize "Thundercloud" stacks based on number of friendly units hit in this attack. When "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receives a killing blow, target seizes a set number of "Thundercloud" stacks. If all "Thundercloud" stacks have been seized, this unit will enter the Weakness Break state.

skill_list.skill_desc: When it is sunny, the environment will have "<u>Temperature</u>." At the start of any target's turn, "<u>Temperature</u>" rises. DMG dealt by targets will increase based on "<u>Temperature</u>." All targets enter the "Solar Storm" state. At the start of a target's turn, deals Fire DMG based on the "<u>Temperature</u>." This DMG is "<u>Non-fatal</u>." When "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receive a killing blow, "<u>Temperature</u>" is lowered.

240150101.name: Temperature
240150101.desc: The current temperature on the battlefield. Allies will take continuous Burn DMG based on the temperature. DMG dealt by ally targets increases based on Temperature.

401403001.name: Non-fatal
401403001.desc: When the target receives DMG, if their HP is insufficient, reduces their HP to 1.
